# Upstream

- Project: Wren
- Repository: https://github.com/wren-lang/wren
- Commit: 99d2f0b8fc2686134b32b18166e037639f7e9f2c
- Reference implementation: src/vm/wren_vm.c and src/vm/wren_vm.h

This directory contains a small standalone collector derived from Wren's
non-moving mark-sweep design. It does not include the Wren VM, bytecode,
parser, object model, or standard library.
